name: @penguinharness/wikiskill-rsi-toolkit
description: WikiSkill RSI Toolkit: compile training trajectories into a persistent wiki and reusable skills, retain only improvements on a held-out validation set, and evaluate the final skill set on isolated test tasks.

penguin.title: WikiSkill RSI Toolkit
penguin.description_zh: WikiSkill RSI 工具包：将训练轨迹整理为持久 Wiki 和可复用技能，仅保留在独立验证集上提升的技能包，并在隔离的测试任务上评估最终技能包。
penguin.short_description: Evolve reusable skills from a persistent training wiki.
penguin.short_description_zh: 从持久训练 Wiki 迭代生成可复用技能。

quick_start.prompt: Use the `rsi-wikiskill` Skill in this fresh conversation to prepare an experiment with my selected benchmark, model/provider, runtime and budget. Act as Controller and create or verify only this experiment’s dedicated Target through Penguin’s native commands; I do not need to create Agents manually. Check the training/validation split, evaluation boundaries and adapter. Report readiness and the next action; start task execution only when I request it. Preserve existing experiments and results.
quick_start.prompt_zh: 在这个新对话中使用 `rsi-wikiskill` 技能，按我选择的 Benchmark、模型与服务商、运行环境和预算准备实验。你作为 Controller，通过 Penguin 原生命令按需创建或核验本次专用 Target，无需我手工创建智能体。检查训练/验证划分、评测边界和适配器，报告就绪情况与下一步；我要求执行时才启动做题。保留已有实验与结果。
